headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. The Washington Nationals also secured a win, defeating the San Diego Padres 9-4, ending their opponent's winning streak. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Konnor Griffin of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Bailey Ober of the Minnesota Twins, Angel Zerpa of the Milwaukee Brewers, Craig Kimbrel of the Tampa Bay Rays, Harrison Bader of the San Francisco Giants, Welinton Herrera of the Colorado Rockies, Luis Severino of the Athletics, and Pierce Johnson of the Cincinnati Reds. 

The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, and RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for Future Considerations. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to White Sox in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, ending their opponent's winning streak. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Texas**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals lost to the Texas Rangers 7-6, with Carter Jensen leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Seth Lugo pitched 6 strong innings for the Royals, striking out 6 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Albert Suárez earning the win. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. led the Blue Jays with 4 hits, while Brandon Young pitched 6.2 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Fall to Orioles in 5-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays suffered a 5-9 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Nathan Lukes and Ernie Clement leading the Jays' offense. Meanwhile, Gunnar Henderson and Yohendrick Piñango contributed to the Orioles' victory.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 2-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Jackson Merrill and CJ Abrams leading the Padres' offense. James Wood and Luis García Jr. contributed to the Nationals' win, while Keibert Ruiz also had a notable performance.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Griffin on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates shortstop Konnor Griffin has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right elbow strain. Griffin's status is now changed.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.
